title: Juicy Cozy Canadian Beef Stir-fry
description: An earthy and juicy Canadian-inspired dish featuring tender beef, blanched tomatoes, and a touch of cozy comfort food flavors without added sugars.
instructions: Wash the beef, tomatoes, onion, and garlic. Pat dry the beef with paper towels.
Slice the beef thinly against the grain. Blanch the tomatoes in boiling water for about 1 minute. Drain and set aside.
Dice the onion and mince the garlic finely. Peel and chop the peanuts (optional).
In a large pan, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the diced onions and cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add minced garlic and sauté for another minute until fragrant. Add blanched tomatoes and peanuts (if using) to the pan with the beef slices. Stir well to combine.

Pour in soy sauce and stir well to coat all ingredients evenly. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper to taste, then cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the beef is cooked through but still juicy.
Garnish with chopped green onions before serving.
